2: func bubbleSort(arr)
  2: block
    3: var(const) a = array[...arr]
    4: for [var(let) i = 0] [(i < (a.length - 1))] [(i++)]
      4: block
        5: for [var(let) j = 0] [(j < ((a.length - 1) - i))] [(j++)]
          5: block
            6: if (a[j] > a[(j + 1)])
              6: block
                7: expr (array[a[j], a[(j + 1)]] = array[a[(j + 1)], a[j]])
    11: return a
14: func binarySearch(arr, target)
  14: block
    15: var(let) lo = 0, hi = (arr.length - 1)
    16: while (lo <= hi)
      16: block
        17: var(const) mid = Math.floor(((lo + hi) / 2))
        18: if (arr[mid] === target)
          18: return mid
        19: if (arr[mid] < target)
          19: expr (lo = (mid + 1))
          else
          20: expr (hi = (mid - 1))
    22: return (- 1)

26: var(const) sorted = bubbleSort(data)
27: expr console.log(sorted, data)
28: expr console.log("indeks 25:", binarySearch(sorted, 25), "indeks 7:", binarySearch(sorted, 7))

    34: expr console.log((out || i))

    73: switch true
      74: case (score >= 90)
        74: return "A"

        75: return "B"
      76: default
        76: return "C"
